The '''R2a Astromech Head''' was a head part for [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]]. That dome-shaped head was among the main components of the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]].
